title: Understand an unfamiliar repository
summary: Turn a named project file into an explanation you can check against the source.
input: A project file and a question
benefit: Keep project-specific instructions in a reusable agent instead of repeating them in every conversation.

title: Find the gaps in your documentation
summary: Let an explorer gather the context and a specialist identify what a new contributor needs.
output: Three concrete findings and a next action
benefit: Give the reviewer its own instructions, then reuse it from other agents. Inspect the complete recorded run.

title: Turn scattered notes into a research brief
summary: Compare supplied source notes, preserve attribution, and separate evidence from open questions.
output: A comparison and questions to investigate
benefit: Start with supplied notes, then add web-page ingestion and indexed retrieval when your research grows.

title: Review a change against the requirements
summary: Read a supplied patch and acceptance criteria, then produce findings tied to the changed lines.
output: A review checklist with suggested tests
preview: Suggested test → a name with two words
benefit: Make your review checklist repeatable. Add a specialist or explicitly configured test command as a separate extension.

title: Generate a project report from a script
summary: Run one request without the terminal UI and save the conversation as an inspectable artifact.
benefit: Use the same file-based authoring model from a shell script or CI job, with a fresh transcript for each independent run.

title: Keep a workflow running after you disconnect
summary: Learn the host lifecycle with a real timer, then extend it with background research jobs.
input: A daemon session and a scheduled event
output: An observable completion after client detach
preview: Timer → completion handled by the host
benefit: Separate the lifetime of the work from the lifetime of the terminal. Background research uses the documented model-job recipe as an extension.
